narrative.intro: MVM has obligated $234M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. The company won 6 awards in the current fiscal year to date for an average award size of $39.1M, and obligations are up 26.0% year over year. The Department of Homeland Security is the primary buyer, obligating $234M to MVM in FY2026 to date. Security Guards and Patrol Services is the largest NAICS market for MVM, with $234M in obligations in FY2026 to date. Historical obligations show year-to-year variation: FY21 $497M, FY22 $769M, FY23 $303M, FY24 $344M, FY25 $186M, and FY26 $234M. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date obligations. These figures show a concentrated FY2026 profile driven by one agency and one market, and they provide a basis for comparing MVM to peers on agency concentration, market focus, award count, and average award size.
